feed.title: NPR Topics: Climate
feed.subtitle: NPR's full coverage of climate change and related issues.

entry.title: The U.S.-Venezuela oil deal won't lower your gas prices. Here's what you need to know
entry.summary: The Trump administration announced a deal Friday to develop a vast amount of Venezuela's oil reserves, with the U.S. taking a majority stake. Energy experts say there are many reasons to be skeptical.

entry.title: NPR spent 2 years tracking deaths from heat. We found a staggering hidden toll
entry.summary: An NPR investigation found that people in the U.S. are dying from heat much more often than official counts show. We explore the reasons why — and how lives can be saved.

entry.title: Arizona's taps won't run dry, but water bills will go up under federal plan for Colorado River
entry.summary: New federal rules mean Arizona will be getting a lot less water from the Colorado river. City leaders say they've been planning for years and no one will run out, but keeping taps flowing is expensive.

entry.title: Urban climate expert Brian Stone on how cities must adapt to survive deadly heat waves
entry.summary: NPR's Scott Simon talks about how cities must change to survive deadly heat waves with Georgia Tech researcher Brian Stone.

entry.title: A melting glacier contributed to the deadly Nepal floods. We can expect more like this
entry.summary: As the climate continues to warm, scientists warn that the frequency of disasters like the floods in Nepal will increase.

entry.title: The role of climate change in the Nepal floods
entry.summary: The deadly flash floods in Nepal are not a surprise to many scientists. Glacial melt is accelerating because of climate change, putting millions of people at risk.

entry.title: Floods kill more than 670 people in Nepal and Tibet, with 90 Americans among the missing
entry.summary: Both countries say over 3,000 people remain missing, with more than half of them foreign nationals.

entry.title: School districts face a back-to-school math problem: The high price of diesel
entry.summary: With the war in Iran driving up fuel prices, diesel is now nearly $5.60 a gallon, affecting school districts at the start of the year.

entry.title: Nearly 1,000 are missing in Nepal and Tibet after floods caused by a glacial collapse
entry.summary: China's Xinhua News Agency said Thursday that mudslides in Tibet caused by a glacial collapse have left three people dead and 558 missing, while police in Nepal reported at least 162 were killed.

entry.title: California's rolling out a new rule requiring more efficient tires
entry.summary: NPR's Adrian Florido talks with Ken Rider of the California Energy Commission about a new rule for more efficient tires, which could cut the greenhouse gas emissions that cause climate change.
